_meta.note: Initial data.json. postasb/fblog/slate/track carried over from the page. fblog.g starts empty for all teams (fallback = team games handles existing history); the pipeline writes explicit g entries for slate starters nightly, 0 for first-timers. Pipeline refreshes slate/track/fblog nightly.

fblog._about: Team-first field goal history. seed = 2026-27 games through Oct 27 where the team scored the game's first FG (JediBets): [n, {player:count}]. log = each team's first FG per game, appended daily. g = games started per player per team (seeded g_i = n_T for scorers; refined nightly from Basketball Monster lineups).

slate.note: 7 games · post-All-Star '25-26 + '26-27 blend, first-basket history, first-shot tendency, Covers lines, tip records

games.tipNote: Wendell Carter Jr. vs Alex Sarr

track._about: Nightly model predictions frozen at slate time (p = model first-basket prob with history as of that night; pa = away team scores-first prob). act = actual first FG of the game, filled the next day.

nfl.note: Week 11 First TD — team first-TD rates from 2026 nflverse PBP (shrinkage r=(c+5)/(n+10)), log5 team prob plus fitted home-field shift (+0.467 logit), player shares 0.5*TD share + 0.5*red-zone-touch share, history blend K=20. Lines: ESPN/DraftKings. Poff (first TD offensive) = 0.9799.

anytime.note: Week 11 Anytime TD -- P = 1-exp(-lam), lam = team expected offensive TDs x player share of team TDs. Team rate shrunk 5 games toward league average (lam_league = 2.480 off TDs/team-game). Same top-5 players and shares as First TD.

props.note: Points: Normal(mean, sd) from season game logs. Threes: Poisson(mean 3PM). Reference line = nearest .5 to the mean (the model's median line, NOT a book line). Book lines are entered by hand on the page; the pipeline never copies a book line.
